verdict.rationale: Veo is offered through an API (Gemini API, Interactions API), so a separate sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode, or isolated environment. Multi-turn refinement and the free consumer apps (Gemini, Flow) are different features, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt describing one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
